messages.author: 8b7866227a4376a2
messages.subject: Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection
parts:
Dear Olga and Meena, I'm new to MSstats and starting to learn.

I'd like to use QC function as skyline external tool with DDA data .

DDA data - excel format - were derived from sorcerer search program and converted to csv file according to guide line.














In spite of several times of trying, i failed, following message.

 ================================================================
 ** Loading the required statistical software packages in R ..... 
 
Loading required package: Rcpp


 =======================================
 ** Reading the data for MSstats..... 
Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection


 Can't finish analysis.
 ================================================================

I don't know what's the problem, please help me.

messages.author: 701dadf5d5bd3f3b
messages.subject: Re: Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection
parts:
Hello,

the error message means that R cannot find the input file. Please check your working directory (use the 'getwd()' command), and make sure that the path to the input file is specified correctly starting from the working directory.

I hope this helps
Olga

messages.author: df9ba0266a9a081f
messages.subject: Re: Error in file(file, "rt") : cannot open the connection
parts:
Hello,

What I understand is that .csv file is not from Skyline. and below commends seems to use MSstats external tool in Skyline.
10 required format and MSstats report format in Skyline are little different. So, MSstats external tool in Skyline automatically take care of MSstats report format (not 10 required format). So if you want to use .csv file from other Skyline tool, please use example R script in msstats.org

hope to help you.

--Meena
